notes:
- 新增：模块版本自检，脚本过旧会在连接设置页提示重新导入（需重导一次模块才会显示版本号）
- 修复：连接设置页可能仍显示「模块已连接」，实际客户端已关闭；现在每次进入都重新检测
- 修复：关闭虚拟定位后旧连接不释放，出现「关了还生效」
- 修复：断网超过离线宽限期仍可继续使用；现在要求联网校验一次
- 修复：把系统时间往回拨可以绕过离线期限
- 修复：第三方模式下诊断页误报「根证书已信任」
- 修复：下载更新后点取消，安装包仍会落盘
notesEn:
- New: module version check; an outdated script now prompts a re-import in Connection Settings (re-import once to see the version)
- Fixed: Connection Settings could still say "module connected" after the client was closed; it now re-probes on every entry
- Fixed: closing spoofing left old connections open, so it looked like it was still active
- Fixed: the app stayed usable after the offline grace period; online verification is now required once
- Fixed: moving the system clock backwards bypassed the offline limit
- Fixed: Diagnostics wrongly reported "root certificate trusted" in third-party mode
- Fixed: cancelling after a download still wrote the package to disk
